Berserker.name: Berserker
Berserker.description:
Este incautious fighter can become a terrifying harbinger of destruction.

Melee 1 falchion (forceful, sweep), Damage 1d10 slashing

Str +3, Dex +0, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +2

Puntos de Golpe 8

Kit Armor bonificador por objeto +3, Dex cap +2

Skills Athletics, Intimidation, Warfare Lore

Follower Ability When a berserker takes daño, they gain a +1 bonificador de estado to their next tirada de daño before the end of tu next turn.

Experienced Advancement When the berserker becomes an experienced follower:

  • Increase their Strength modifier to +4 and their Constitution modifier to +3.
  • Increase their proficiency rank with Fortitude and Will saves to experto.
  • Increase their falchion Golpe dados de daño from 1d10 to 2d10.
  • Increase the bonificador de estado to tiradas de daño the berserker gains from their follower ability to +2.

Veteran Advancement When the berserker becomes a veteran follower:

  • Increase their Constitution modifier to +4, their Wisdom modifier to +1, and their Charisma modifier to +3.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to AC to +4.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Perception to experto.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Athletics, Intimidation, and Warfare Lore to experto.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in their falchion Golpes to experto, and give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with their falchion Golpes. Their Golpes deal 3 daño adicional and become magical for the purposes of ignoring resistances.
  • Increase the bonificador de estado to tiradas de daño the berserker gains from their follower ability to +3.

  • The berserker gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.yYN5lYVfJVofjR0k]{Reckless Attack}.

Exceptional Advancement When the berserker becomes an exceptional follower:

  • Increase their Strength modifier to +5, their Dexterity modifier to +1, their Wisdom modifier to +2, and their Charisma modifier to +4.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to AC to +5.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Fortitude saves and Will saves to maestro, and their proficiency rank in Reflex saves to experto. Give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to all tiradas de salvación.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Athletics to maestro.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with their falchion Golpes to +2. Increase their falchion Golpe dados de daño from 2d10 to 3d10 and increase the daño adicional that their falchion Golpes deal from 3 to 6.
  • Increase the bonificador de estado to tiradas de daño the berserker gains from their follower action to +4.

  • The berserker gains a reaction when Directed. If this reaction isn't spent before the beginning of tu next turn, it is lost. The berserker also gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.7jjDVIT39HUAnrP6]{Share the Pain} reaction.

Leader of All (Elf).name: Leader of All (Elf)
Leader of All (Elf).description:
Tú accept anyone who would follow tú on tu adventures. Puedes take followers from any common ancestry, and from uncommon or rare ancestries at the GM's discretion.

Tu follower gains the rasgos, size, Velocidades, languages, and other special abilities listed in their ancestry. For example, elf followers have the elf and humanoid rasgos, a 30-pies speed, low-light vision, and the typical languages for elves.

Followers don't use their ancestry's Puntos de Golpe or attribute boosts and flaws. They also don't gain abilities that would allow them to use actions beyond the standard ones available to a follower, such as Activating an Item or Lanzando un conjuro.

Note: Este feat has been set up for an elf follower. For other ancestries set the senses and languages from the details tab, and rasgos and base speed from the rules tab. If needed, see the Creature Size rule element in the quickstart guide for rule elements.

Medic.name: Médico
Medic.description:
Este trainee healer can maestro the art of bringing people back from the brink of death.

Melee 1 scalpel (agile, deadly d8, finesse, versatile S), Damage 1d4 piercing (functions as dagger)

Str +0, Dex +2, Con +1, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +0

Puntos de Golpe 6

Kit Armor bonificador por objeto +1, Dex cap +4

Skills Herbalism Lore, Medicine, Nature, Survival

Follower Ability A medic has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} feat. Their kit includes a healer's kit.

Experienced Advancement When the medic becomes an experienced follower:

  • Increase their Dexterity modifier to +3 and their Wisdom modifier to +4.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Fortitude saves and Will saves to experto.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Medicine to experto.
  • Increase their scalpel Golpe dados de daño from 1d4 to 2d4. Their scalpel Golpes deal 1 daño persistente de sangrado (1d6 daño persistente de sangrado on a critical hit).

  • Una vez al día, the medic can use Battle Medicine on a criatura that is temporarily immune.

Veteran Advancement When the medic becomes a veteran follower:

  • Increase their Strength modifier to +1, their Dexterity modifier to +4, and their Constitution modifier to +2.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to AC to +2.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Perception to experto.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Medicine to maestro, and their proficiency rank in Herbalism Lore, Nature, and Survival to experto. Give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to Medicine checks.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in their scalpel Golpes to experto, and give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with their scalpel Golpes. Their scalpel Golpes deal 2 daño adicional and become magical for the purposes of ignoring resistances.

  • The medic can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.ma45EqTK72KQLca3]{Medic's Treatment}.

Exceptional Advancement When the medic becomes an exceptional follower:

  • Increase their Strength modifier to +2, their Constitution modifier to +3, their Intelligence modifier to +2, and their Wisdom modifier to +5. Increase their bonificador por objeto to AC to +3.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Fortitude and Will saves to maestro, and their proficiency rank in Reflex saves to experto. Give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to all tiradas de salvación.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to Medicine checks to +2. They become an experto in Acrobatics. Increase their bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with their scalpel Golpes to +2. Increase their scalpel Golpe dados de daño from 2d4 to 3d4 and increase the daño adicional that their scalpel Golpes deal from 2 to 4. Increase the persistent bleed their scalpel Golpes deal to 2 (or 2d6 on a critical hit).
  • Una vez por hora, the medic can use Battle Medicine on a criatura that is temporarily immune. The medic can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.32cPs0J3Dk19Q743]{Quick Treatment}.

Scout.name: Batidor
Scout.description:
Este novice lookout can become a maestro of traversing terrain silently to strike their foes' weak points.

Melee 1 shortsword (agile, finesse, versatile S), Damage 1d6 piercing

Str +1, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +2, Cha +0

Puntos de Golpe 6

Kit Armor bonificador por objeto +1, Dex cap +4

Skills Acrobatics, Stealth, Survival, one Lore about a specific settlement or a specific terrain

Follower Ability A scout deals 1d4 daño adicional de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} targets.

Special A scout adds Scout to the list of exploration activities that they can perform without spending tu exploration activity.

Experienced Advancement When the scout becomes an experienced follower:

  • Increase their Dexterity modifier to +4 and their Wisdom modifier to +3.
  • Increase their proficiency rank with Reflex saves, Will saves, and Perception to experto.
  • Increase their shortsword Golpe dados de daño from 1d6 to [[/r 2d6]].

  • Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} to the list of exploration activities the scout can perform without spending tu exploration activity.

Veteran Advancement When the scout becomes a veteran follower:

  • Increase their Strength modifier to +2, their Constitution modifier to +2, and their Intelligence modifier to +1.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to AC to +2.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Acrobatics, Stealth, Survival, and their specific Lore to experto. Give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to Stealth checks.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in their shortsword Golpes to experto, and give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with their shortsword Golpes. Their Golpes deal 2 daño adicional and become magical for the purposes of ignoring resistances.
  • Increase the daño adicional de precisión the scout does to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} targets to [[/r 1d6]].
  • The scout learns Exploit Injury.

Exceptional Advancement When the scout becomes an exceptional follower:

  • Increase their Strength modifier to +3, their Dexterity modifier to +5, their Constitution modifier to +3, and their Wisdom modifier to +4.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to AC to +3.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Reflex saves, Will saves, and Perception to maestro, and their proficiency rank in Fortitude saves to experto. Give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to all tiradas de salvación.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Stealth to maestro, and increase their bonificador por objeto to Stealth checks to +2.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with their shortsword Golpes to +2. Increase their shortsword Golpe dados de daño from 2d6 to 3d6 and increase the daño adicional that their shortsword Golpes deal from 2 to 4.
  • When the scout uses the Scout exploration activity, they also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}.

Sharpshooter.name: Tirador de primera
Sharpshooter.description:
Este trainee archer can learn to shoot with terrifying precision.

Range 1 shortbow (deadly d10, propulsive, range increment 60 pies, reload 0), Damage 1d6 piercing

Str +0, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +2, Cha +1

Puntos de Golpe 4

Kit Armor bonificador por objeto +1, Dex cap +4

Skills Acrobatics, Hunting Lore, Stealth

Follower Ability The sharpshooter learns Take Aim.

Experienced Advancement When the sharpshooter becomes an experienced follower:

  • Increase their Dexterity modifier to +4 and their Wisdom modifier to +3.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Fortitude saves and Reflex saves to experto.
  • Increase their shortbow Golpe dados de daño from 1d6 to [[/r 2d6]].

  • When a criatura takes daño from a sharpshooter's ranged Golpe, it takes a –5-pies penalización de circunstancia to its Velocidades for 1 round, or a –10-pies penalización de circunstancia if the attack was a critical hit.

Veteran Advancement When the scout becomes a veteran follower:

  • Increase their Constitution modifier to +2, their Intelligence modifier to +1, and their Charisma modifier to +2.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to AC to +2.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Perception to experto.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Acrobatics, Hunting Lore, and Stealth to experto. They also become an experto in Intimidation.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in their shortbow Golpes to experto, and give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with their shortbow Golpes. Their Golpes deal 2 daño adicional and become magical for the purposes of ignoring resistances.

  • When the sharpshooter Takes Aim, they also ignore el objetivo's concealment.

Exceptional Advancement When the sharpshooter becomes an exceptional follower:

  • Increase their Dexterity modifier to +5, their Constitution modifier to +3, their Wisdom modifier to +4, and their Charisma modifier to +3.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to AC to +3.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Reflex saves and Will saves to maestro and their proficiency rank in Fortitude saves to experto. Give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to all tiradas de salvación.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Acrobatics to maestro.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with their shortbow Golpes to +2. Increase their shortbow Golpe dados de daño from 2d6 to 3d6 and increase the daño adicional that their shortbow Golpes deal from 2 to 4.

  • The sharpshooter learns Following Shot.

Shieldbearer.name: Shieldbearer
Shieldbearer.description:
Este aspiring bodyguard can learn to deflect the most devastating of blows.

Melee 1 longsword (versatile P), Damage 1d8 slashing

Melee 1 shield boss, Damage 1d6 bludgeoning

Str +3, Dex +1, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +0

Puntos de Golpe 8

Kit Armor bonificador por objeto +5, Dex cap +1

Skills Athletics, Survival, Warfare Lore

Follower Ability A shieldbearer carries a shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10). They can Raise the Shield to gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC. The shieldbearer also gains a reaction when Directed. If this reaction isn't spent before the beginning of tu next turn, it is lost. Finally, they gain the Shield Block feat.

Special A shieldbearer takes a –5-pies penalización to their Velocidades from their heavy armor.

Experienced Advancement When the shieldbearer becomes an experienced follower:

  • Increase their Strength modifier to +4 and their Constitution modifier to +3.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Fortitude and Will saves to experto.
  • Increase their armas' Golpe daño from one die to two dice (for instance 1d8 to 2d8).
  • Increase their shield's statistics to Hardness 6, HP 40, and BT 20.

  • The shieldbearer can defend tú. When the shieldbearer has their shield raised, they can use their Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against tú as long as they are adjacent to tú. If they do, the shield prevents tú from taking daño up to the shield's Hardness, but tú and the shield each take any remaining daño, following the normal rules for Shield Block.

Veteran Advancement When the shieldbearer becomes a veteran follower:

  • Increase their Constitution modifier to +4, their Intelligence modifier to +1, and their Wisdom modifier to +2.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to AC to +6. Their armor gains the bulwark rasgo.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Perception to experto.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Athletics, Survival, and Warfare Lore to experto. They become an experto in Crafting and add a repair toolkit to their kit.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in arma Golpes to experto, and give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with their arma Golpes. Their arma Golpes deal 2 daño adicional and become magical for the purposes of ignoring resistances.
  • Increase their shield's statistics to Hardness 8, HP 64, BT 32.

  • The shieldbearer can now defend anyone. The shieldbearer can use Shield Block to protect any adjacent ally, not just tú.

Exceptional Advancement When the shieldbearer becomes an exceptional follower:

  • Increase their Strength modifier to +5, their Dexterity modifier to +2, their Intelligence modifier to +2, and their Wisdom modifier to +3.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to AC to +7.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Fortitude saves and Will saves to maestro, and their proficiency rank in Reflex saves to experto. Give them a +1 bonificador por objeto to all tiradas de salvación.
  • Increase their proficiency rank in Athletics to maestro. They become an experto in Acrobatics.
  • Increase their bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with their listed arma Golpes to +2. Increase their arma Golpe daño from two dice to three dice (for instance, 2d8 to 3d8) and increase the daño adicional that their arma Golpes deal from 2 to 4.
  • Increase their shield's statistics to Hardness 10, HP 100, BT 50.

  • The shieldbearer gains an additional reaction when Directed, which the shieldbearer can use only to Shield Block to protect themself.

Veteran Advancement.name: Veteran Advancement
Veteran Advancement.description: Tu experienced follower becomes a veteran follower.
